{
  "dataset_name": "postcutoff_ro_real_estate_20260503",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "area_per_room",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average area per room, indicating spaciousness.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 181.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous measure of room size, which is often linearly correlated with property value.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "area_sqm / np.maximum(rooms, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_area_sqm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed area to reduce skewness and linearize relationships.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.21],
      "feature_family": "transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Helps linear models handle right-skewed area distributions more effectively.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(area_sqm)"
    },
    {
      "name": "floor_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Floor number normalized to a 0-1 scale.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Keeps feature scales consistent for SVM margin calculations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(floor + 1.0) / 55.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_ground_or_basement",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for ground floor or basement properties.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the non-linear value drop often associated with lowest floors in a linear-friendly way.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(floor <= 0.0, 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized title feature.",
      "value_range": [0.02, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Scales the title feature for stable SVM optimization.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "title / 132.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "location_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized location feature.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Scales the location feature for stable SVM optimization.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "location / 36.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "area_location_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction between normalized area and normalized location.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the linear model to capture the combined effect of size and location.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(area_sqm / 181.0) * (location / 36.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "rooms_to_floor_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of rooms to floor level.",
      "value_range": [0.01, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures architectural patterns (e.g., large apartments on lower vs higher floors).",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "rooms / np.maximum(floor + 2.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "scraped_at_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized scraping timestamp.",
      "value_range": [0.001, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a scaled temporal feature for the linear model.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "scraped_at / 2828.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "spaciousness_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "An index measuring how spacious the property is beyond a baseline of 15 sqm per room.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous severity measure of spaciousness, useful for linear margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((area_sqm - 15.0 * rooms) / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "luxury_semantic_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of luxury level based on the combination of area, rooms, and floor.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures non-linear luxury concepts in a single continuous score suitable for linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "location_desirability_estimate",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic estimation of location desirability based on the location ID and property characteristics.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Translates categorical or opaque location IDs into a continuous desirability score.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
